findings.note: ESPN lists Detroit at 1-3-1 (1-3-0 at home) after losing four of its last five. Kasper, Appleton and Compher are on IR and Edvinsson is out. Gibson has an .862 save percentage, and Detroit's penalty kill is at 70%. NJ's Brown and Bjugstad are on IR.

The Devils team preview, dated Oct. 13, says New Jersey (2-3-0) closes a back-to-back in Detroit less than 24 hours after a 4-1 home loss to Ottawa. That points to fatigue and a possible backup goalie. NJ went 2-1-0 against Detroit last season.
ESPN's scoreboard shows the market as close to a coin flip, NJ -105 and DET -115. So the -110 offered on Detroit is a little better than that listed price, not a clear outlier.
